title: Cashless decision: one hour
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 15(b), p.23
quote: immediately but not more than one hour of receipt of request.
plain_en: The insurer must decide on a cashless request within 1 hour of receiving it. Ask for the insurer/TPA receipt time.
plain_hi: कैशलेस अनुरोध मिलने के 1 घंटे के अंदर बीमा कंपनी को फैसला करना है। कंपनी या TPA से अनुरोध मिलने का समय लिखित में लें।
caveat: Receipt by the insurer is the stated trigger. A family-entered submission time is evidence supplied by the user, not independent proof. The circular does not separately name enhancement requests.

title: Final discharge authorisation: three hours
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 16(a), p.23
quote: Insurer shall grant final authorization within three hours of the receipt of discharge authorization request from the hospital.
plain_en: Final cashless approval is due within 3 hours after the insurer receives the hospital’s discharge request.
plain_hi: अस्पताल का डिस्चार्ज अनुरोध मिलने के 3 घंटे के अंदर बीमा कंपनी को अंतिम कैशलेस मंजूरी देनी है।

title: Do not keep the patient waiting
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 16(a), p.23
quote: In no case, the policyholder shall be made to wait to be discharged from the Hospital.
plain_en: The circular says you should not be kept waiting for discharge. Ask the desk and insurer to act now.
plain_hi: परिपत्र कहता है कि पॉलिसीधारक को डिस्चार्ज के लिए इंतजार नहीं कराया जाना चाहिए। अस्पताल और बीमा कंपनी से तुरंत कार्रवाई माँगें।

title: Extra hospital charges after a three-hour delay
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 16(b), p.23
quote: the additional amount if any charged by the hospital shall be borne by the insurer from shareholder’s fund.
plain_en: If final approval is delayed beyond 3 hours, the insurer must bear any additional hospital charge caused by that delay. Keep the bill and timestamps.
plain_hi: अंतिम मंजूरी में 3 घंटे से ज्यादा देरी हो तो उससे लगे अतिरिक्त अस्पताल शुल्क बीमा कंपनी को देने हैं। बिल और समय का प्रमाण रखें।
caveat: No fixed hourly compensation is created. Link the additional charge to the delay; do not treat every unpaid part of the hospital bill as recoverable under this clause.

title: Immediate help after a death
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 16(c)(i)-(ii), p.23
quote: immediately process the request for claim settlement.
plain_en: If the policyholder dies during treatment, the insurer must process the claim request and arrange release of the body immediately.
plain_hi: इलाज के दौरान पॉलिसीधारक की मृत्यु हो जाए तो बीमा कंपनी को दावा तुरंत प्रोसेस करना है और पार्थिव शरीर तुरंत दिलवाना है।
additional_quote: get the mortal remains (dead body) released from the hospital immediately

title: Insurer/TPA collects hospital documents
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 17(c), p.24
quote: Insurers and Third Party Administrators (TPAs) shall collect the required documents from the Hospitals.
plain_en: After the claim is reported, the insurer/TPA must collect needed documents from the hospital. The policyholder should not have to submit those documents.
plain_hi: दावे की सूचना के बाद बीमा कंपनी या TPA को जरूरी कागज़ अस्पताल से लेने हैं। पॉलिसीधारक से ये कागज़ जमा कराने की माँग नहीं होनी चाहिए।

title: Review before a claim is repudiated
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 17(a), p.23; Protection Circular Part B V.3(iii).4, p.121
quote: No claim shall be repudiated without the approval of PMC
plain_en: A repudiation needs approval by the Product Management Committee or its three-member Claims Review Committee. Ask which body approved it and when.
plain_hi: दावा खारिज करने के लिए Product Management Committee या उसकी तीन सदस्यों वाली Claims Review Committee की मंजूरी चाहिए। पूछें किस समिति ने कब मंजूरी दी।
caveat: The operative sentence names repudiation. Do not assert that every ordinary deduction or partial disallowance necessarily requires CRC approval; ask whether that deduction is being treated as repudiation.

title: Specific policy reasons for deductions
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 17(b), p.24; Protection Circular Part B V.3(iii).5, p.121
quote: giving reference to the specific terms and conditions of the policy document.
plain_en: For a rejected or partly disallowed claim, ask for the full reasons and the exact policy terms for each disputed amount.
plain_hi: दावा खारिज हो या कुछ राशि काटी जाए, तो पूरे कारण और हर विवादित कटौती के लिए पॉलिसी की सटीक शर्त माँगें।

title: Complaint acknowledgement and response
paragraph: Protection of Policyholders’ Interests Master Circular, 5 September 2024, Section 1 Part B VI.2(i), p.123
quote: Insurers should provide resolution to the complaint within 14 days
plain_en: The insurer must acknowledge your complaint immediately and should resolve it within 14 days, with reasons and policy terms if it is not accepted.
plain_hi: बीमा कंपनी को शिकायत मिलते ही उसकी पावती देनी है और 14 दिनों में समाधान देना चाहिए। शिकायत न माने तो कारण और पॉलिसी की शर्त बतानी चाहिए।
caveat: This is the insurer grievance deadline. It is not the separate one-month no-reply prerequisite for the Ombudsman.

title: When you can approach the Ombudsman
paragraph: Council for Insurance Ombudsmen FAQs 8, 9, 10, 11 and 15
quote: You are not satisfied with the response given by Insurance Company/Insurance Broker
plain_en: First complain to the insurer. You may approach the free Ombudsman route after an unsatisfactory/rejected response, or no reply for one month. The claim/compensation limit is ₹50 lakh. Usually file within one year of the rejection/unsatisfactory decision or expiry of that month. The same dispute must not be pending or decided in court, a consumer forum or arbitration.
plain_hi: पहले बीमा कंपनी से शिकायत करें। जवाब से संतुष्ट न हों, शिकायत खारिज हो जाए, या एक महीने तक जवाब न मिले, तो मुफ्त बीमा लोकपाल सेवा में जा सकते हैं। सीमा ₹50 लाख है। आम तौर पर असंतोषजनक फैसले या उस एक महीने के खत्म होने से एक साल के अंदर शिकायत करें। वही मामला अदालत, उपभोक्ता आयोग या मध्यस्थता में लंबित या तय नहीं होना चाहिए।
caveat: One month is a calendar month, not always 30 days. Reminder dates are planning aids, not a calculation of legal limitation. FAQ contains repeated legacy sections; use the updated ₹50 lakh section and formal rules if scope is disputed.

title: Ombudsman award: compliance and delay payment
paragraph: Protection of Policyholders’ Interests Master Circular, 5 September 2024, Part B VI.4(i)-(iv), p.124; Section 2 Chapter VII 25.1-25.4, p.148
quote: a penalty of Rs. 5000/- per day shall be payable to the complainant for each day of delay.
plain_en: The insurer must comply within 30 days of receiving the Ombudsman award. ₹5,000 per delayed day applies, in addition to applicable penal interest, unless the insurer appeals within 30 days and informs you.
plain_hi: लोकपाल का आदेश मिलने के 30 दिनों में बीमा कंपनी को पालन करना है। देरी पर लागू ब्याज के साथ हर दिन ₹5,000 देय हैं; 30 दिनों में अपील करके आपको सूचना देने पर यह प्रावधान लागू नहीं होता।
caveat: Do not present ₹5,000/day as compensation for a hospital discharge delay or as unconditional while a timely appeal is filed.

title: Check the policy before judging room-linked deductions
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter III IV, p.30; Annexure 6 item 19, p.44
quote: This Circular supersedes all the Guidelines/Circulars listed in Annexure-6.
plain_en: Ask for the room limit, the deduction formula and the exact policy clause. A room-related cut to another bill item needs review against your policy and the hospital bill. It is not automatically valid or invalid.
plain_hi: कमरे की सीमा, कटौती का हिसाब और पॉलिसी की सटीक शर्त माँगें। कमरे के कारण अन्य मदों की कटौती पॉलिसी और अस्पताल के बिल से जाँचें। वह अपने-आप सही या गलत नहीं हो जाती।
caveat: 151/06/2020 and the 2020 standardisation master circular are expressly superseded. A blanket 2024 ban on proportionate surgeon/OT/ICU/pharmacy deductions was not established. Historical non-medical item lists are not a universal current coverage rule. Policy/add-on and bundling terms must be checked.

title: You file your own IRDAI complaint
paragraph: IRDAI Grievance Redressal Mechanism, 30 August 2022
quote: Only complaints from the insured or the claimants shall be entertained.
plain_en: ClaimClock prepares text. You review it and file it yourself with IRDAI. IRDAI’s complaint contacts are 155255, 1800 4254 732 and complaints@irdai.gov.in.
plain_hi: ClaimClock शिकायत का मसौदा बनाता है। आप उसे जाँचकर खुद IRDAI को भेजते हैं। संपर्क: 155255, 1800 4254 732 और complaints@irdai.gov.in।

title: Consumer Commission and the current filing portal
paragraph: Consumer Protection Act 2019, section 69(1)-(2), PDF p.28; e-Jagriti official migration notice
quote: within two years from the date on which the cause of action has arisen.
plain_en: Consumer complaints normally have a 2-year limit from the cause of action; the Commission can allow delay for sufficient cause. The current online filing portal is e-Jagriti, which absorbed e-Daakhil in January 2025.
plain_hi: उपभोक्ता शिकायत आम तौर पर विवाद का कारण पैदा होने से 2 साल में करनी होती है। उचित कारण हो तो आयोग देरी माफ कर सकता है। ऑनलाइन शिकायत अब e-Jagriti पर होती है; e-Daakhil जनवरी 2025 में इसमें शामिल हो गया।
caveat: Cause of action depends on the facts. Do not automatically set the legal deadline at discharge plus two years. Seek advice before choosing parallel forums.

title: Policy-specific room limits, sub-limits, co-pay and deductible
paragraph: Annexure 1 to Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Customer Information Sheet item 8, PDF p.3
quote: The policy will pay only up to the limits specified hereunder
plain_en: The 2024 Customer Information Sheet requires disclosure of policy financial limits, including room/ICU sub-limits, co-payment and deductibles. Verify the actual policy limit and calculation; the form does not impose one universal cap.
plain_hi: 2024 की ग्राहक सूचना शीट में कमरे/ICU की उप-सीमा, सह-भुगतान और डिडक्टिबल सहित पॉलिसी की वित्तीय सीमाएँ बतानी हैं। अपनी पॉलिसी की सीमा और हिसाब जाँचें; यह प्रारूप कोई एक समान सीमा लागू नहीं करता।
caveat: This is the prescribed disclosure format, not a universal room-rent cap or a ban on proportionate deductions. Associated-expense reductions need the actual policy wording and hospital tariff; the 2020 circular was superseded.

title: 60-month moratorium on non-disclosure
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 13, p.22
quote: No policy and claim of health insurance shall be contestable on any grounds of non-disclosure and/or misrepresentation except for established fraud, after the completion of the Moratorium Period, i.e. 60 months of continuous coverage
plain_en: After 60 months (5 years) of continuous coverage, including credits from ported and migrated policies, a policy or claim cannot be contested for non-disclosure or misrepresentation, except for established fraud.
plain_hi: 60 महीने (5 साल) के लगातार कवरेज के बाद, जिसमें पोर्ट और माइग्रेट की गई पॉलिसियों की अवधि भी जुड़ती है, स्थापित धोखाधड़ी को छोड़कर गैर-प्रकटीकरण या गलत जानकारी के आधार पर पॉलिसी या दावे पर आपत्ति नहीं की जा सकती।
caveat: Established fraud remains an exception, and increases in sum insured may have separate continuous-coverage clocks. Keep all renewal and portability records.

title: Claiming across multiple policies (Corporate + Personal)
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 18(a), p.24
quote: the primary Insurer shall seek the details of other available policies of the policyholder and shall coordinate with other Insurers to ensure settlement of the balance amount as per the policy conditions, without causing any hassles to the policyholder.
plain_en: If you hold more than one health policy (such as corporate plus personal), you may choose which policy to claim under first. If the admissible claim exceeds that policy's cover, the primary insurer must coordinate with your other insurer(s) to settle the balance under policy terms.
plain_hi: यदि आपके पास एक से अधिक स्वास्थ्य पॉलिसी (जैसे ऑफिस और व्यक्तिगत) हैं, तो आप चुन सकते हैं कि पहले किस पॉलिसी में दावा करना है। यदि अनुमन्य राशि उस पॉलिसी के कवर से अधिक है, तो प्राथमिक बीमा कंपनी को शेष राशि के निपटान के लिए दूसरी बीमा कंपनी से समन्वय करना है।

title: Free look: 30 days to cancel a new policy
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 5, p.21
quote: A period of 30 days (from the date of receipt of the policy document) is available to the policyholder to review the terms and conditions of the policy. If he/she is not satisfied with any of the terms and conditions, he/she has the option to cancel his/her policy.
plain_en: You have 30 days from the day you receive the policy document to read it and cancel if it is not what you were promised. It applies to policies with a term of one year or more; the refund deducts only the proportionate risk premium for the days covered, any medical-examination cost and stamp duty.
plain_hi: पॉलिसी दस्तावेज़ मिलने के दिन से 30 दिन तक आप उसे पढ़कर रद्द कर सकते हैं, अगर वह वादे के मुताबिक नहीं है। यह एक साल या उससे अधिक अवधि की पॉलिसियों पर लागू है; रिफंड में केवल कवर के दिनों का आनुपातिक जोखिम प्रीमियम, मेडिकल जाँच का खर्च और स्टाम्प शुल्क कटता है।
caveat: The 30 days run from receipt of the policy document, not from the premium payment; keep proof of the delivery date. The refund basis is stated in the PPHI Master Circular, Section 1 Part B III.2(ii), p.118.
title_hi: फ्री लुक: नई पॉलिसी रद्द करने के लिए 30 दिन

title: Free-look refund within 7 days
paragraph: Protection of Policyholders’ Interests Master Circular, 5 September 2024, Citizens’ Charter (Health), Basic Service Standards item 1, p.156
quote: Free look cancellation and refund of deposit from the date of receipt of the request: 7 days
additional_quote: Irrespective of the reasons mentioned, insurer must accept the request of the policyholder to exercise the option of free look period.
plain_en: Once you ask for free-look cancellation, the insurer must accept the request whatever your reason and complete the cancellation and refund within 7 days of receiving it.
plain_hi: फ्री-लुक रद्दीकरण का अनुरोध करने पर बीमा कंपनी को, कारण चाहे जो हो, अनुरोध स्वीकार करना है और उसे मिलने के 7 दिनों के अंदर रद्दीकरण और रिफंड पूरा करना है।
caveat: The 7-day figure is the regulatory turnaround time in the Citizens’ Charter (Health); the acceptance sentence is Section 1 Part B III.2(ii), p.118. Interest on a delayed free-look refund is stated expressly for life policies (Part A); for a health policy cite the turnaround time and use the grievance route.

title: Grace period: 15 or 30 days to renew without losing credits
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 8(a)–(b), p.21–22
quote: The grace period of fifteen days (where premium is paid on a monthly instalments) and thirty days (where premium is paid in quarterly/half-yearly/annual instalments) is available on the premium due date, to pay the premium.
additional_quote: If the policy is renewed during grace period, all the credits (sum insured, No Claim Bonus, Specific Waiting periods, waiting periods for pre-existing diseases, Moratorium period etc.) accrued under the policy shall be protected.
plain_en: If you miss the renewal date you still have 15 days (monthly premium) or 30 days (quarterly, half-yearly or annual premium) to pay. Renew inside that window and every credit — sum insured, no-claim bonus, waiting periods served, moratorium months — is protected. Unless you pay in instalments, there is no cover for the days between the due date and the late payment.
plain_hi: नवीनीकरण की तारीख चूक जाए तो भी भुगतान के लिए 15 दिन (मासिक प्रीमियम) या 30 दिन (तिमाही, छमाही या वार्षिक प्रीमियम) मिलते हैं। इस अवधि में नवीनीकरण करने पर बीमित राशि, नो-क्लेम बोनस, पूरी हो चुकी प्रतीक्षा अवधि और मोरेटोरियम के महीने — सब सुरक्षित रहते हैं। किस्तों में भुगतान न हो तो देय तारीख से देर से भुगतान के बीच के दिनों में कवर नहीं रहता।
caveat: Coverage during the grace period is available only when the premium is paid in instalments during the policy period (Chapter I 9). After the grace period the policy lapses and continuity credits are lost. The IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024, Schedule III 1.3 and 9.3, state the same grace period and that a delay condoned within it is not a break in policy.
title_hi: ग्रेस अवधि: क्रेडिट खोए बिना नवीनीकरण के लिए 15 या 30 दिन

title: Renewal cannot be refused for claiming, and no fresh underwriting
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 10(b)–(c), p.22
quote: An Insurer shall not deny the renewal on the ground that the policyholder had made a claim (s) in the preceding policy years.
additional_quote: An Insurer shall not resort to fresh underwriting unless there is an increase in sum insured.
plain_en: A health policy is renewable unless the product is withdrawn or there was established fraud, non-disclosure or misrepresentation. The insurer cannot refuse renewal because you claimed, and cannot ask for medical tests or a fresh proposal form at renewal unless you raise the sum insured.
plain_hi: स्वास्थ्य पॉलिसी का नवीनीकरण होना ही है, जब तक उत्पाद बंद न हुआ हो या स्थापित धोखाधड़ी, गैर-प्रकटीकरण या गलत जानकारी न हो। दावा करने के कारण कंपनी नवीनीकरण से मना नहीं कर सकती, और बीमित राशि बढ़ाए बिना नवीनीकरण पर मेडिकल जाँच या नया प्रस्ताव फॉर्म नहीं माँग सकती।
caveat: If the product itself is withdrawn, the insurer must offer migration to another product (Chapter I 10(a)); a withdrawn product is not a ground to leave you uncovered. The IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024, Schedule III 9.1–9.2 and 9.5, p.38, restate both rules.
title_hi: दावा करने पर नवीनीकरण से मना नहीं, और नई अंडरराइटिंग नहीं

title: Renewal premium is priced for the portfolio, not your claims
paragraph: IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations, 2024, Schedule III 9.4, p.38
quote: For individual products, the loadings on renewal premium shall be at portfolio and not based upon any individual policy claim experience.
plain_en: For an individual policy, a renewal premium increase must apply to the whole product (the portfolio), not to you because you claimed. An insurer may give you a discount for a good claim record, but not a claim-based loading.
plain_hi: व्यक्तिगत पॉलिसी में नवीनीकरण प्रीमियम की बढ़ोतरी पूरे उत्पाद (पोर्टफोलियो) पर लागू होनी चाहिए, न कि दावा करने के कारण सिर्फ आप पर। अच्छे दावा रिकॉर्ड पर छूट दी जा सकती है, लेकिन दावे के आधार पर लोडिंग नहीं।
caveat: Premiums rise legitimately when you move into a higher age band or raise the sum insured, and a product-wide rate revision approved for the portfolio is lawful. The rule forbids only claim-based individual loading.
title_hi: नवीनीकरण प्रीमियम पोर्टफोलियो पर तय होता है, आपके दावों पर नहीं

title: Senior citizens: premium revision capped at 10% a year
paragraph: IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/27/1/2025, 30 January 2025, paragraph 7(a)–(b), p.3
quote: The insurers shall not revise the premium for senior citizens by more than 10% per annum.
additional_quote: In the following cases, insurers shall undertake prior consultation with the IRDAI: a. If the increase proposed in the premium for senior citizens is more than 10% per annum. b. In case of withdrawal of individual health insurance products offered to senior citizens.
plain_en: For indemnity-based individual health policies held by senior citizens (aged 60 and above), insurers may not revise premium rates by more than 10% a year; a larger revision, or withdrawing such a product, requires prior consultation with IRDAI. The direction took effect on 30 January 2025.
plain_hi: वरिष्ठ नागरिकों (60 वर्ष और अधिक) की क्षतिपूर्ति-आधारित व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य पॉलिसियों में बीमा कंपनियाँ प्रीमियम दरें साल में 10% से अधिक नहीं बढ़ा सकतीं; इससे अधिक बढ़ोतरी या ऐसा उत्पाद बंद करने से पहले IRDAI से परामर्श ज़रूरी है। यह निर्देश 30 जनवरी 2025 से प्रभावी है।
caveat: The cap is on revision of the product’s premium rates. Moving into a higher age band at renewal, a higher sum insured or a changed plan can raise your premium without a rate revision; ask the insurer to show which part of the increase is a rate revision. The circular is a direction to insurers; the GRO and Bima Bharosa routes are how a policyholder raises a breach. The circular is a scanned document; the quotation was read from the official PDF.
title_hi: वरिष्ठ नागरिक: प्रीमियम संशोधन साल में 10% तक सीमित

title: Porting: apply 30 to 60 days before renewal
paragraph: Protection of Policyholders’ Interests Master Circular, 5 September 2024, Section 2 Chapter VI 24.2, p.147
quote: A policyholder desirous of porting his/her policy to another insurer shall apply to such insurer to port the entire policy along with all the members of the family, if any, at least 30 days before, but not earlier than 60 days from the due date for renewal.
additional_quote: Provided that Insurers are free to consider proposal for portability even if the policyholder has approached within 15 days from the renewal date of the existing policy, but in all such cases acquiring insurer shall ensure that there is no break in policy.
plain_en: Apply to the new insurer between 60 and 30 days before your renewal date, for the whole policy and every family member on it. Inside 30 days the new insurer may still accept you — up to 15 days before renewal — but it is not obliged to. Portability is available on individual, family floater and group policies at renewal.
plain_hi: नवीनीकरण की तारीख से 60 से 30 दिन पहले नई बीमा कंपनी को पूरी पॉलिसी और उस पर शामिल हर सदस्य के लिए आवेदन करें। 30 दिन से कम बचे हों तो नई कंपनी नवीनीकरण से 15 दिन पहले तक आवेदन मान सकती है, लेकिन बाध्य नहीं है। पोर्टेबिलिटी व्यक्तिगत, फैमिली फ्लोटर और समूह पॉलिसियों पर नवीनीकरण के समय उपलब्ध है।
caveat: Many policy wordings still print the earlier 45-day window from the repealed IRDAI (Health Insurance) Regulations 2016; the September 2024 circular governs, and applying 45 days ahead remains the safer plan. The same text appears in Section 1 Part B VII.3(vi), p.125–126. Do not let the existing policy lapse while the proposal is pending.
title_hi: पोर्टिंग: नवीनीकरण से 30 से 60 दिन पहले आवेदन

title: Porting: your old insurer shares records within 72 hours
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 12(b), p.22
quote: The existing insurer shall provide the information sought by the Acquiring insurer immediately but not more than 72 hours of receipt of request
plain_en: The new insurer requests your policy and claim history through the IIB portal; your existing insurer must supply it immediately, and within 72 hours at most. If the port stalls, ask both insurers in writing for the date the request was raised and answered.
plain_hi: नई बीमा कंपनी IIB पोर्टल के ज़रिए आपकी पॉलिसी और दावों का इतिहास माँगती है; मौजूदा कंपनी को यह तुरंत, अधिकतम 72 घंटे में देना है। पोर्टिंग अटके तो दोनों कंपनियों से लिखित में पूछें कि अनुरोध किस तारीख को भेजा और उसका जवाब कब दिया गया।
caveat: The 72 hours run from the existing insurer’s receipt of the request through the IIB portal, not from your application to the new insurer. Restated in the PPHI Master Circular, Section 2 Chapter VI 24.5, p.147.
title_hi: पोर्टिंग: पुरानी कंपनी 72 घंटे में रिकॉर्ड साझा करती है

title: Porting: the new insurer decides within 5 days
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 12(c), p.22
quote: The Acquiring insurer shall decide and communicate on the proposal immediately but not more than 5 days of receipt of information from Existing insurer.
plain_en: Once it has your records from the old insurer, the new insurer must decide your porting proposal and tell you — within 5 days at most. Ask for the decision and its reasons in writing.
plain_hi: पुरानी कंपनी से रिकॉर्ड मिलने के बाद नई बीमा कंपनी को अधिकतम 5 दिनों में आपके पोर्टिंग प्रस्ताव पर निर्णय लेकर आपको बताना है। निर्णय और उसके कारण लिखित में माँगें।
caveat: The 5 days count from receipt of information from the existing insurer. Acceptance remains subject to the new insurer’s board-approved underwriting policy; the deadline is for the decision, not a guarantee of acceptance.
title_hi: पोर्टिंग: नई कंपनी 5 दिनों में निर्णय देती है

title: Porting carries your credits; no porting charges
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 12(d), p.22
quote: The policyholder is entitled to transfer the credits gained to the extent of the Sum Insured, No Claim Bonus, specific waiting periods, waiting period for pre-existing disease , Moratorium period etc from the Existing Insurer to the Acquiring Insurer in the previous policy.
additional_quote: No charges shall be levied on the policyholder for porting-in or porting-out.
plain_en: When you port, the waiting periods you have already served, the moratorium months, your no-claim bonus and your sum insured carry over to the new policy up to the previous policy’s limits. Neither insurer may charge you for porting in or out. Ask the new insurer to confirm the transferred credits in writing on the schedule.
plain_hi: पोर्ट करने पर पूरी हो चुकी प्रतीक्षा अवधि, मोरेटोरियम के महीने, नो-क्लेम बोनस और बीमित राशि पिछली पॉलिसी की सीमा तक नई पॉलिसी में जुड़ते हैं। पोर्ट-इन या पोर्ट-आउट के लिए कोई भी कंपनी शुल्क नहीं ले सकती। नई कंपनी से हस्तांतरित क्रेडिट की लिखित पुष्टि अनुसूची पर माँगें।
caveat: Credits transfer to the extent of the previous sum insured; an enhanced sum insured starts fresh waiting periods on the enhanced portion. Disclose every condition afresh in the new proposal — porting does not cure a non-disclosure. The no-charges sentence is the PPHI Master Circular, Section 2 Chapter VI 24.7, p.147.
title_hi: पोर्टिंग में क्रेडिट साथ जाते हैं; कोई पोर्टिंग शुल्क नहीं

title: Migration: apply 30 days before renewal
paragraph: IRDAI Guidelines on Migration and Portability of health insurance policies, IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/003/01/2020, 1 January 2020, paragraph 7, p.2
quote: A policyholder desirous of migrating his/her policy shall be allowed to apply to the insurance company to migrate the policy along with all members of the family, if any, atleast 30 days before the premium renewal date of his/her existing policy.
plain_en: To move to another product of the same insurer, apply at least 30 days before your renewal date, for all family members on the policy. The insurer may accept a later request but need not. No charge may be levied for migration.
plain_hi: उसी बीमा कंपनी के दूसरे उत्पाद में जाने के लिए नवीनीकरण की तारीख से कम से कम 30 दिन पहले, पॉलिसी के सभी सदस्यों के लिए आवेदन करें। कंपनी देर से आया अनुरोध मान सकती है, पर बाध्य नहीं है। माइग्रेशन के लिए कोई शुल्क नहीं लिया जा सकता।
caveat: These Guidelines were issued under the IRDAI (Health Insurance) Regulations 2016, since repealed by the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024; they are not among the circulars superseded by the 2024 Health Master Circular (Annexure 6). Treat the 30 days as the practical window and check your policy wording. The no-charge sentence is paragraph 8 of the same Guidelines.
title_hi: माइग्रेशन: नवीनीकरण से 30 दिन पहले आवेदन

title: Migration carries your credits; no underwriting after 36 months
paragraph: IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations, 2024, Schedule III 10.1, p.38
quote: shall provide an option of migration to an alternative health insurance product to the extent of the sum insured and the benefits available in the previous policy. The insurer may underwrite the proposal in case of migration, if the insured is not continuously covered for 36 months.
additional_quote: the policyholder (including all members under family cover and group insurance policies) can transfer the credits gained to the extent of the Sum Insured, No Claim Bonus, Specific Waiting periods, waiting period for pre-existing diseases, Moratorium period etc. in the previous policy to the migrated policy.
plain_en: Every indemnity health insurer must offer migration to another of its products, carrying your sum insured and benefits. After 36 months of continuous cover the insurer cannot underwrite you afresh on migration; before that it may. Waiting periods served, the moratorium months and the no-claim bonus move with you.
plain_hi: हर क्षतिपूर्ति स्वास्थ्य बीमा कंपनी को अपने दूसरे उत्पाद में माइग्रेशन का विकल्प देना है, जिसमें आपकी बीमित राशि और लाभ साथ जाते हैं। 36 महीने के लगातार कवर के बाद माइग्रेशन पर कंपनी नई अंडरराइटिंग नहीं कर सकती; उससे पहले कर सकती है। पूरी हो चुकी प्रतीक्षा अवधि, मोरेटोरियम के महीने और नो-क्लेम बोनस आपके साथ जाते हैं।
caveat: Credits transfer to the extent of the previous sum insured and benefits; a richer new product may carry fresh waiting periods for the additional benefits only. The credits sentence is the Health Master Circular, Chapter I 11, p.22.
title_hi: माइग्रेशन में क्रेडिट साथ जाते हैं; 36 महीने बाद अंडरराइटिंग नहीं

title: Leaving a group policy: your right to an individual policy
paragraph: IRDAI Guidelines on Migration and Portability of health insurance policies, 1 January 2020, paragraph 3, p.2
quote: Every individual member, including family members covered under an indemnity based group health insurance policy shall be provided an option of migration at the time of exit from group or in the event of modification of the group policy (including the revision in the premium rates) or withdrawal of the group policy: a. to an individual health insurance policy or a family floater policy.
additional_quote: Insurers shall allow portability in respect of all individual, family floater and group health insurance policies at the time of renewal.
plain_en: When you leave an employer’s group policy, or the group policy is changed or withdrawn, you can ask the same insurer to migrate you to an individual or family floater policy, carrying the credits you built up; the insurer may underwrite you. You may also port the group cover to another insurer at renewal. Apply before your last covered day so there is no break.
plain_hi: नियोक्ता की समूह पॉलिसी छोड़ने पर, या समूह पॉलिसी बदलने या बंद होने पर, आप उसी बीमा कंपनी से व्यक्तिगत या फैमिली फ्लोटर पॉलिसी में माइग्रेशन माँग सकते हैं, जिसमें बने हुए क्रेडिट साथ जाते हैं; कंपनी अंडरराइटिंग कर सकती है। नवीनीकरण के समय समूह कवर को दूसरी कंपनी में पोर्ट भी किया जा सकता है। कवर के आखिरी दिन से पहले आवेदन करें ताकि कोई अंतराल न हो।
caveat: Migration from a group policy is subject to underwriting (Guidelines paragraph 6(b)); the insurer can decline or load the proposal. The Guidelines rest on the repealed 2016 Regulations but are not listed as superseded; the portability right for group policies is the PPHI Master Circular, Section 2 Chapter VI 24.1, p.147, and the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024, Schedule III 10.2.
title_hi: समूह पॉलिसी छोड़ते समय: व्यक्तिगत पॉलिसी का आपका अधिकार

title: A health proposal is decided within 7 days
paragraph: Protection of Policyholders’ Interests Master Circular, 5 September 2024, Citizens’ Charter (Health), Basic Service Standards item 1, p.156
quote: Decision on proposal from the date of receipt of proposal or from the date of receipt of additional requirement whichever is later: 7 days
plain_en: A migration or new-policy proposal must be decided within 7 days of the insurer receiving it, or of receiving the last additional document it asked for. Any further requirement should itself be raised within 7 days of the proposal.
plain_hi: माइग्रेशन या नई पॉलिसी के प्रस्ताव पर, बीमा कंपनी को प्रस्ताव या उसके माँगे गए आखिरी अतिरिक्त दस्तावेज़ के मिलने से 7 दिनों के अंदर निर्णय देना है। कोई और ज़रूरत भी प्रस्ताव के 7 दिनों के अंदर बतानी चाहिए।
caveat: The January 2020 Migration Guidelines mention a 15-day underwriting decision under the 2017 PPHI Regulations, since replaced; the current Citizens’ Charter turnaround is 7 days. For a porting proposal the specific 5-day rule from receipt of the old insurer’s information applies.
title_hi: स्वास्थ्य प्रस्ताव पर 7 दिनों में निर्णय

title: No GST on individual health insurance since 22 September 2025
paragraph: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance — Exemption of GST on all Individual Life Insurance and Health Insurance Policies (Notification No. 16/2025-Central Tax (Rate), 17 September 2025), Q1 and Q4
quote: GST rate on all Individual Life Insurance and Individual Health Insurance policies, including reinsurance of the same, has been reduced from 18% to zero and it has come into effect on 22nd September 2025.
additional_quote: the exemption is explicitly for all INDIVIDUAL life and health insurance policies and the 18% GST rate will be applicable on Group Insurance policies.
plain_en: From 22 September 2025 there is no GST on individual health policies, including family floaters and senior-citizen plans; group and employer policies still carry 18%. Removing 18% GST lowers an unchanged bill by about 15.25%, so compare the premium before tax to see the real change.
plain_hi: 22 सितंबर 2025 से व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य पॉलिसियों पर, फैमिली फ्लोटर और वरिष्ठ नागरिक योजनाओं सहित, GST नहीं है; समूह और नियोक्ता की पॉलिसियों पर 18% लागू है। 18% GST हटने से बिना बदले बिल लगभग 15.25% कम होता है, इसलिए असली बदलाव देखने के लिए कर-पूर्व प्रीमियम की तुलना करें।
caveat: GST applies as on the date of premium payment. Insurers lost input tax credit on the exempt policies and some repriced; the GST change and a base-premium revision are separate things.
title_hi: 22 सितंबर 2025 से व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य बीमा पर GST नहीं
